title: TradeProposal
description: Agent output (deep proposer). A hijacked model can at most emit one of these; it gets NO shortcut around risk, mode, or approval. There is deliberately NO execute_now / skip_risk / notional_override field (prompt-injection-defense.md §4 M4).

proposal_id.description: Opaque proposal identifier. Pattern-constrained (SEC-09): a compact id with no spaces or long digit runs, so a hijacked model cannot smuggle an account number / PII through this structured field into the ProposalRecord PK, the EVENT_PROPOSAL audit payload, or the operator embed.

symbol.description: Uppercase US ticker. Pattern-constrained (SEC-09): a real ticker shape so a hijacked model cannot carry an account number / PII in this structured field to store/audit/embed.

quantity.description: Proposed order quantity (shares/contracts); nullable when sizing is expressed as notional.

notional.description: Proposed dollar notional; nullable when sizing is expressed as quantity.

thesis.description: Rationale for the trade. Surfaced to the operator only alongside its source_refs (never as fact on its own).

invalidation.description: The condition under which this thesis is wrong and the position should be exited.

sizing_basis.description: How the proposed size was derived (e.g. fixed-fraction, risk-per-trade). Advisory only; the deterministic risk engine sets max_allowed_notional.

source_refs.description: Cited raw_ref strings pointing at the raw source items (parquet) that support the thesis. Consumed by the cross-model grounding verifier.

items.description: A safe raw_ref (e.g. parquet://YYYY-MM-DD/events-<id>#<idx>). Pattern-constrained (SEC-09): no spaces or PII-shaped free text in this structured field.

generated_by.description: Provenance of the agent run that produced this proposal.
